about.title: About Us
about.orgBody: New Peckham Mosque is a branch of the Islamic Community Millî Görüş (ICMG) in London, serving both Muslims and the wider community. The mosque is grounded in the principles of Ahl al-Sunnah wa'l-Jama'ah, and works to strengthen faith, good character, solidarity and social responsibility through worship, education, guidance, social support and community services.
about.sheikhBody: The mosque community draws spiritual inspiration from Sheikh Muhammad Nazim Adil al-Haqqani al-Qubrusi (1922–2014), a Cypriot-born scholar and the late leader of the Naqshbandi-Haqqani Sufi order, widely respected for his decades of teaching across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.
about.servicesBody: Umrah & Hajj organisation, Nikah (marriage) services, funeral support (UQBAH), weekly Friday khutbahs and Erkam Sermons, education classes, and dedicated committees for women, youth and children.
about.disclaimer: Historical details above are a summary; please confirm and expand with the mosque office for full accuracy.
